maintenance_items.notes: Perform at number of miles, kilometers or months, whichever comes first.
Rotate tires every 7,500 mi/6 mo. When rotating tires, check for damage and uneven wear.
Replace every 15,000 mi/12 mo. When driving for prolonged periods in dusty conditions, replace more frequently.
Lubricate propeller shaft grease every 15,000 mi/12 mo. The propeller shaft should be regreased after being immersed in water.

Request a NISSAN dealer to inspect the fluid deterioration data using a CONSULT. If the deterioration data is more than 77000, replace the AT fluid. Appears at 15,000/30,000/45,000/60,000/75,000/90,000/105,000/120,000 mi.

Visually inspect for signs of leakage.

Replace every 30,000 mi/24 mo. If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent); synthetic 0W-20 SP GF-6A may be used if above not available. API certification or ILSAC certification required.
fluids.capacity: 5-1/4 qt with oil filter change; 5 qt without oil filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. 50% antifreeze/50% water. Antifreeze protection to -34°F (-37°C).
Genuine NISSAN Matic P ATF or equivalent. Do not mix with other fluids.

severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km).
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing.
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic.
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use.
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads.
Towing a trailer, using a camper or using a car-top carrier.
extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule is presented as individual mileage columns (not a simple repeating table), so repeat intervals were inferred by observing the pattern across all columns.
2. Automatic transmission fluid: standard schedule calls for inspection (dealer CONSULT check) at 15,000/30,000/45,000/60,000/75,000/90,000/105,000/120,000 mi; severe schedule calls for replacement every 30,000 mi/24 mo (at 30k/60k/90k severe sections only — not at every severe interval).
3. Intelligent Key battery: first inspected at 22,500 mi/18 mo (standard), first replaced at 45,000 mi/36 mo (standard), then replaced at 67,500 mi/54 mo, 90,000 mi/72 mo, 112,500 mi/90 mo (all standard). The pattern is every 22,500 mi/18 mo alternating inspect/replace.
4. Differential gear oil and transfer fluid: standard schedule lists inspection at 15,000/30,000/45,000/60,000/75,000/90,000/105,000/120,000 mi; severe schedule lists replacement at 20,000/40,000/60,000/80,000/100,000 mi.
5. ATF capacity and differential/transfer fluid specifications and capacities are not provided in the extracted pages.
6. Brake fluid specification not stated in extracted pages.
7. Power steering fluid specification not stated in extracted pages.
8. Items marked with * in the schedule are 'recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation' and are not required to maintain emission warranty or manufacturer recall liability.
9. Engine coolant: repeat interval is 75,000 mi/60 mo after first replacement at 105,000 mi/84 mo (per note (3) on p505).
10. Engine drive belts inspection appears at 60,000/75,000/90,000/105,000/120,000 mi — not perfectly uniform intervals.
